prompts.selection: Create a dedicated high-resolution character selection portrait for Sam Porter Bridges from DEATH STRANDING. Reference1 is approved game model, reference2 original character design. SAME rugged adult male face, tousled medium brown hair, blue eyes, brown stubble, tired yet determined expression, exact navy BRIDGES porter suit with orange/yellow straps and amber BB capsule just hinted at lower edge. Close bust: complete hair and head, neck and both shoulders only, no arms/hands/fullbody. Face large, centrally framed, head top with small comfortable breathing room, shoulders span almost canvas width. Threequarter gaze slightly RIGHT toward viewer, clearly visible face. Sharp premium detailed cel-shaded anime-game illustration with subtle blue rim light, perfectly clean contour and painterly face detail, same identity/proportions as approved model. Background genuinely transparent alpha. No titles, labels, words, panels, other characters, fog, shadows or copied image-sheet layout. Cargo backpack may peek behind shoulders but not dwarf head. A blue Odradek small cropped side detail optional, do not obscure face. This is bespoke portrait artwork, not an enlarged small game sprite.

prompts.corrections:
Create a production animation correction strip for Sam Porter Bridges, DEATH STRANDING. Approved first reference gives EXACT game model: adult brown hair stubble, navy porter suit, amber chest BB, yellow straps, two gray/yellow backpack cases, black gloves/boots, Odradek. Second reference is flawed attack sheet: preserve identity and body scale but create specified corrected strike poses. Transparent alpha, NO WORDS/labels/frames/background/ground/opponent/effects. ONE ROW of FOUR fullbody figures, evenly spaced with wide gutters. Same physical body scale across poses; complete hair/feet/hands/case inside each cell. Crisp high quality sharp cel shaded detail as first approved model. All face RIGHT except natural torso twist.
Cell1 exact neutral standing right-facing pose from first reference for size calibration.
Cell2 sideways heavy normal attack CONTACT frame: Sam is braced with feet separated, upper torso twisted right, both arms swinging ONE gray cargo case from his left to his RIGHT. Cargo box MUST now be to the RIGHT of his torso at WAIST height, both hands reaching to RIGHT, chest BB visible. DIFFERENT silhouette from straight forward case jab or long lunge. Sideways swing finishing right with elbow bent, trailing left shoulder.
Cell3 down smash CONTACT frame: deep wide squat, torso leans forward, both hands extend DOWN to slam one broad gray/yellow case into the ground just RIGHT of his front boot. Case bottom level with boot soles. NO cargo over head, NO raised case. Distinct wide planted squat from kneeling down tilt.
Cell4 up smash CONTACT frame: powerful straight upward thrust of a gray/yellow cargo case with both hands overhead, hands visibly TOUCH underside of case; box no higher than top quarter of cell. Legs planted strongly, chest up, arms fully extended UP. Not a free flying separate object. Keep proportionate face, no oversized head.
Do not copy the original sheet layout. Four separate fullbody sprites only.
